defects: Ring hypothesis strengthened: gold only needs [Semiring R] [Nontrivial R], produced requires [CommRing R] [IsDomain R], a strictly narrower class of rings (adds commutativity, no zero divisors), so the produced statement is a special case rather than the same generality as gold

Torsion hypothesis spelled as r ≠ 0 ∧ r • m = 0 rather than mathlib's IsTorsion predicate (∃ r ∈ nonZeroDivisors R, r • m = 0); these coincide only because IsDomain forces nonzero elements to be non-zero-divisors, so the produced hypothesis is not a faithful unfolding of IsTorsion in the general setting gold uses
